annotation_description: With a hand containing Katara (GWU), Hakoda (3W), Earth Kingdom Protectors (W), and Earthen Ally (G), the player needs colored mana early. Floodfarm Verge produces W unconditionally and can produce U once a Plains or Island is controlled. Jasmine Dragon Tea Shop only produces colorless mana freely, with colored mana restricted to Ally spells/abilities. Playing Floodfarm Verge turn 1 would allow casting Earth Kingdom Protectors (W) on turn 2 with any second land, and better sets up the mana base for Katara on turn 3. Jasmine Dragon Tea Shop's colored mana can only be used on Ally spells, which is relevant but less flexible, and its colorless-first sequencing delays the curve. Since the player likely wants to play a W creature on turn 2, Floodfarm Verge is the better turn-1 land.
human_notes: It's an Ally deck. Jasmine Dragon Tea Shop casts all their spells.

annotation_description: Spending Burst Lightning (a versatile burn spell that can deal 4 when kicked) to kill Earthen Ally, which is currently just a 1/2 with a very expensive activated ability. The opponent's real threats will be cards like Katara or Hakoda, and this burn spell would be much more impactful against those. Earthen Ally is low-impact in the near term.
human_notes: Earthen Ally was indestructible until EOT.

annotation_description: Used Warp to cast Nova Hellkite, which exiles it at end of turn, when they had enough mana (5 lands producing {3}{R}{R}) to hardcast it normally. While lethal was available this turn regardless, hardcasting preserves the 4/5 flyer permanently as insurance if something goes wrong.
human_notes: warping allows holding up burst lightning and we can cast the dragon next turn if needed
